items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: Then there was a change of piano players. Dave McKenna, John Bunch, Dill Jones, Dick Wellstood... And so not too many changes in bass players, but the piano players there was a lot of changes.

ctx.x: Basically the work that you’ve gotten over the years has come through word of mouth and you kind of establish a good reputation.

That’s it. I never wanted to be tied down to an agent or anything like that. I’ve always done it through word of mouth, and people know what I can do and that’s how they call you. John Bunch — you remember John Bunch?
